content.text:
I've submitted index 16 (Sb 0.68 / Zn 0.32), which had the highest EQE of the three compositions I measured: **0.0069%**. That composition is close to ZnSb₂O₆, a known zinc antimonate phase.

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 16 | 0.68 | 0.0069 |
| 28 | 0.83 | 0.0060 |
| 20 | 0.77 | 0.0014 |

- **All values are very low.** None of the listed Sb–Zn oxide phases should absorb much light at the 2.7 eV illumination energy. I expect the whole library to be poor.
- **The Zn-rich half was never measured (indices 0–12).** The budget allowed only three merit measurements. I spent the last one on index 20, between the two Sb-rich points, instead of the unmeasured Zn-rich side; it came back lowest of the three. The Zn-rich side should be dominated by wide-gap ZnO and Zn₇Sb₂O₁₂, so I don't expect it to beat 0.0069%. Still, I haven't ruled it out, and if the best composition is there my score will suffer.
- **The 5 XRD measurements went unused.** I didn't check which phases are actually present, so it's an assumption that index 16 is ZnSb₂O₆.
